description: This file defines API routes for login, token authentication, password recovery, and password reset in a FastAPI application, including HTML content for password recovery emails.

classes.name: Token
classes.description: Represents an authentication token issued upon login.

classes.name: Message
classes.description: Represents a message response, typically for status updates.

classes.name: NewPassword
classes.description: Model for new password data during password reset.

classes.name: UserUpdate
classes.description: Model for updating user information, such as password.

methods.name: login_access_token
methods.description: Handles OAuth2 login, returns access token if credentials are valid.

methods.name: test_token
methods.description: Endpoint to verify the validity of an access token.

methods.name: recover_password
methods.description: Initiates password recovery process by sending reset email.

methods.name: reset_password
methods.description: Resets user password after verifying token.

methods.name: recover_password_html_content
methods.description: Provides HTML content for password recovery email, accessible only by superusers.
